You will purge in your usual problem areas with any acid or retinoid if you're a beginner to skin care (lasts about a month). This is is because acids and retinoids buff away any dead skin cells and reveal newer layers of skin over time. Breaking out is when you see acne in abnormal areas because your skin is irritated.
